_source: Verbatim Thai from pototype/accounting-extra.jsx GLRevenueWIP + WIPTransferForm. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in .tsx source, the bank-recon/timeline precedent. Every value RESOLVES in docs/extract/i18n-full.json phrases — checked when this file was generated, not asserted — so tp() renders it. Copy that had no key at all was minted as gl.revrec.* dict keys instead (B-432) and is reached with t(); pure-ASCII labels (GL, Unbilled, Export) are literals, following gl-jv.tsx:217.
